description: A curated collection of personal Claude skills — from adventure trip planning to domain-specific development guides. Built to work across Claude Code and Claude Desktop.

plugins.name: claude-skills
plugins.description:
Personal skills collection for Claude.

Included skills:

• The Traveler — Collaborative trip planning from a vague idea to a complete interactive itinerary. Deep research into hidden gems, adventure activities, wildlife spotting, old towns, and local food. Produces a visual React itinerary with Leaflet route map, interactive timeline, and detailed stop cards with external links.

• Session Handoff — Archives a session into a connected folder on Claude Desktop, rescuing cloud-only files and maintaining a cross-session index that survives a move to another machine or account.

• Context Handover — Hands one local Claude Code session over to the next. Writes a briefing into the project, so the conversation can be cleared without losing the thread, and picks it back up on resume.

• Release Version — Bumps the project version and opens a release pull request with a written changelog. A shell script owns every state change — manifest detection, branching, committing, the PR — so releases are reproducible; the model only writes the prose.

• Evaluate Session — Grades how well you drove a Claude Code session against a catalogue of nineteen numbered AI-use practices: a letter band, the two practices to focus on, and the ones you did well. A script reduces the transcript to a small evidence digest before anything is graded, so assistant prose, tool output and file contents never leave the machine's own model call. Off until you switch it on.

More skills coming soon.
